IDENTITY RESOLUTION

Customer matching

Profiles are linked when at least three known fields match: name, address, phone and email. Phone punctuation and text casing are normalized.

Any one field may change. Connected profiles form a single customer; all their orders contribute to the spending total. Missing fields do not count as matches.

Top 20 customers

Every listed ID belongs to the same reconciled buyer. Rankings cover all dates.

BOOKS SOLD, NOT ORDER COUNT

Most popular author sets

CATALOG LOGIC

Counting author sets

John alone, Paul alone, and John with Paul are three distinct author sets.

John + Paul and Paul + John are the same set. Authors are split at commas, trimmed, deduplicated and sorted before counting. Catalog counts include books with no sales.

Top 20 author sets

Data quality & calculation notes View audit

Prices are parsed with decimal arithmetic. EUR unit prices are converted to USD and rounded to cents before multiplying by quantity. Slash dates use MM/DD/YY; dotted dates use DD.MM.YYYY. All timestamps retain their supplied local calendar date. Invalid dates are left missing.

Publication years outside 1–9999 are marked missing. Missing addresses and shipping are retained as missing. Malformed orders are quarantined rather than silently changed. Ties are preserved for the most popular author set and the best buyer.
